text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Believe. Let's head to the kitchen. It's 
time for a wild mountain vegetable feast.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Explain yourselves, explain! I'm so sorry, 
Believe-san. The two of us were just 
thinking of a birthday gift for you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
First-of-the-season produce. I heard she 
likes eating seasonal ingredients at top 
speed.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I certainly like it. Though I'm not 
so sure about that explanation...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...So, I gathered some. In the mountains. 
I was stopped from going to the sea.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If I left her alone, she'd probably run 
straight into the sea.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Mountain Durandal was utterly useless. 
Complaining about mud, hating bugs, 
refusing to touch anything.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean 'useless'!? The 
paperwork! The guidebook! Keeping lookout 
so we wouldn't get lost!! Didn't I do all 
of that for you?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
“—*cough* Well, one thing led to another 
and I ended up foraging all kinds of 
things, but...”

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a special occasion, I asked 
Believe what her favorite dish was so I 
could make it for her. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No... in order to bring out the absolute 
best flavor from produce in its prime, one 
must take great care and effort.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—So, I will take full responsibility for 
cooking it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Well... It's the result of your hard 
'work,' after all..."
